menu_items.name: Chicken Biryani
menu_items.description: Authentic Hyderabadi dum biryani cooked with tender chicken pieces and long-grain basmati rice.

menu_items.name: Mutton Biryani
menu_items.description: Traditional slow-cooked mutton biryani rich in aromatic spices, herbs, and saffron.

menu_items.name: Paneer Butter Masala
menu_items.description: Creamy paneer cubes cooked in a rich, buttery, spiced tomato-based gravy.

menu_items.name: Butter Naan
menu_items.description: Soft clay oven baked leavened flatbread brushed with fresh melted butter.

menu_items.name: Veg Fried Rice
menu_items.description: Stir-fried rice mixed with finely chopped carrots, beans, peppers, and soy sauce.

menu_items.name: Chicken Fried Rice
menu_items.description: Wok-tossed rice with scrambled eggs, shredded chicken, and spring onions.

menu_items.name: Gobi Manchurian
menu_items.description: Crispy fried cauliflower florets tossed in sweet, sour, and spicy Manchurian sauce.

menu_items.name: Gulab Jamun
menu_items.description: Two milk-solid dumplings fried golden and soaked in warm cardamom sugar syrup.

menu_items.name: Masala Chai
menu_items.description: Freshly brewed hot tea infused with crushed ginger, cardamom, and spices.
